# Mentha × suavis Guss.

First published in Pl. Rar.: 387 (1826)

This hybrid is accepted

The native range of this hybrid is Europe. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome. The hybrid formula is M. aquatica × M. suaveolens.
